column3: “Returned and built” is rendered “rebuilt,” and “Asherah poles” as “Asherim.”
“My name will be” is rendered “My name shall be.”
“Practiced soothsaying” is rendered “practiced witchcraft,” and “necromancer and soothsayer” as “mediums and spiritists.” “Increased to do evil” is rendered “did much evil.”
“The idol of the sculpture” is rendered “the carved image of the idol.”
“I will not repeat to remove” is rendered “I will not again remove”; “by the hand of Moses” is rendered “given through Moses.”
“When he harassed him” is rendered “when he was in distress,” and “entreated the face of” as “entreated.”
“He was entreated by him” is rendered “He was moved by his entreaty.”
“Rebuilt” is rendered “built,” “the wadi” as “the valley,” and “went around the Ophel” as “encircled the Ophel with it.”
“Matters” is rendered “acts,” and “the matters of the kings” as “the records of the kings.”
“The words of Hozai” is rendered “the records of the Hozai”; the word may mean “seers,” and the meaning is uncertain.
“Lay down” is rendered “slept,” and “his house” as “his own house.”
“Killed” is rendered “put to death”; NASB adds “Finally.”
